placements.role: Makes precision bevel and cylindrical gear grinding, cutting and inspection machine tools used to manufacture the high-precision gear and flexspline profiles inside harmonic and cycloidal reducers; one of the few remaining listed pure-plays in gear-grinding machine tools now that Gleason and Liebherr-Verzahntechnik are private and Reishauer and Kapp Niles have stayed private.

evidence.claim: Klingelnberg Group's own business-division description of its gear technology
evidence.source_name: Klingelnberg Group business overview: bevel and cylindrical gear grinding machines
evidence.source_excerpt: As a leading manufacturer of machine tools for cylindrical and bevel gear processing and precision measuring centers for gears and rotationally symmetric components, integrated systems supplier Klingelnberg has a product portfolio that makes it ideally equipped to face such challenges.

placements.role: Manufactures roller-screw-driven electromechanical linear actuators (brushless DC motor plus roller, ball or acme screw) for heavy-load linear motion in defense ground-vehicle applications, the same screw-actuation architecture used in humanoid leg and heavy-load joints.

evidence.claim: Moog markets electromechanical linear actuators for land systems that use a roller screw for linear output.
evidence.source_name: Moog: Electromechanical Linear Actuators for Land Systems
evidence.source_excerpt: A roller screw, ball screw, or acme screw is used for linear output.

placements.role: Through its Exlar brand, manufactures planetary-roller-screw linear actuators marketed as a direct electromechanical replacement for hydraulic and pneumatic cylinders.

evidence.claim: Curtiss-Wright's Exlar FT Series actuators use a planetary roller screw for linear output, positioned as a more robust replacement for ball screws.
evidence.source_name: Curtiss-Wright Actuation Division: About Exlar Automation / FT Series
evidence.source_excerpt: The FT Series actuators use a planetary roller screw mounted inside an extruded aluminum housing, offered in four frame sizes with standard stroke lengths up to 36 inches and a load rating up to 40,000 lbf.

placements.role: Entered the linear-motion market through the 2018 acquisition of Rollon (linear guides, telescopic rails, linear actuators for robotics and aerospace) and expanded the line with Intelligent Machine Solutions (2021) and Nadella, giving Timken a direct linear-guide and actuator product line adjacent to the roller-screw joints used in humanoid legs.

evidence.claim: Timken's own linear-motion business page describes the Rollon (2018), Intelligent Machine Solutions and Nadella acquisitions that built its linear motion portfolio for robotics and aerospace.
evidence.source_name: The Timken Company: Linear Motion for a Forward-Focused World
evidence.source_excerpt: Timken first entered the linear motion market in 2018 when it acquired Rollon, a specialist in linear guides, telescopic rails and linear actuators for challenging industries like robotics and aerospace.
